final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control A1.2 word for word. It is valid until 2027-11-16. The answer covers production databases only. It says nothing about backups of other systems, such as file storage or configuration. If the customer means more than databases, the owner (security@harborlight.example) needs to confirm.

answer:de4ed22b-88ff-448a-9433-c088dfb13: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:47214084-57a7-4d47-b68d-72d8044f0: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:af762d78-fcdb-4643-9824-6ecc54d2d: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:4596ec7f-287a-4fa3-80d5-ea51b5196: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:68e5d417-4f0c-4728-b208-5880ab1e8: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
